faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subheading: Everything you need to know about plans, credits, model architecture, and privacy.

creditDef.q: What is a credit and how does it work?
creditDef.a: Credits represent units of computational work. A standard conversational prompt and response typically consumes around 7 credits. Image generation requires approximately 35 credits, and web-grounded search adds a small surcharge (+3 credits). We charge based on what provider models cost to run, with zero markup tricks.

rollover.q: Do unused credits roll over to the next month?
rollover.a: No. Monthly plan credits expire and reset at the beginning of each billing cycle to maintain sustainable, transparent unit economics. If you ever purchase optional credit top-up packs in the future, those remain valid for 12 months.

cancel.q: Can I cancel my subscription inside the app?
cancel.a: Yes. You can cancel at any time directly in your Account Settings with a single click. There are no retention labyrinths or phone calls required. Upon cancellation, your plan remains active until the end of your current paid billing period.

refund.a: If you are unsatisfied with your subscription within the first 14 days of purchase and have used less than 20% of your monthly credit allowance, contact support for a prompt refund. Unused portions of that cycle's credit grant are reversed.

models.a: Klecx is an independent interface built on top of high-performance third-party AI models (currently Google Gemini Flash-class models for low-latency reasoning and specialized image synthesis). We clearly label each model key and never hide what runs your requests.

privacy.q: Is my conversation data kept private?
privacy.a: Yes. Your prompts, responses, notes, and workspace files are private by default. All data is encrypted in transit and at rest. We do not sell your personal data or use your private conversations to train public models.

featuresPage.heading: Built for how knowledge work actually happens.
featuresPage.subheading: Standard chat interfaces assume conversations are disposable and linear. Klecx provides structure, memory, and precision for sustained thinking.
featuresPage.principlesSubheading: The deliberate decisions behind the Klecx platform.
featuresPage.p1Desc: When you regenerate or edit, earlier answers are not lost. Every response is versioned so you can always step back to inspect prior variations.
featuresPage.p2Desc: Highlighting a passage allows you to explore sub-questions in isolation. Your main workspace remains clean, focused, and free of tangents.
featuresPage.p3Desc: Klecx is an independent user interface connecting you to best-in-class third-party models. You always know what model executes your request and what each turn costs.

aboutPage.heading: Why we built Klecx
aboutPage.subheading: Chat bubbles were designed for messaging friends, not for synthesizing code, legal drafts, or multi-week research.
aboutPage.threadProblemIntro: When working with foundation models, people are constantly fighting the linear chat format:
aboutPage.threadBullet1: You regenerate an answer to get a minor variation, and the previous good response disappears forever.
aboutPage.threadBullet2: You want to ask a question about paragraph 3, so you send a reply — and the model shifts its entire attention away from the original goal.
aboutPage.threadBullet3: Related conversations are buried in a messy chronological sidebar with no way to organize work into folders or projects.
aboutPage.threadProblemOutro: Klecx replaces disposable threads with persistent Workspaces and Projects, gives every response immutable version history, and lets you ask questions directly about specific passages.
aboutPage.disclosureText: Klecx is an independent interface built on top of third-party AI models (currently Google Gemini). We are not Google and we do not claim to own the underlying model weights. We provide a specialized, developer-grade workspace client that unlocks stateful multi-turn reasoning, passage annotations, version tracking, and document exports.
aboutPage.privateText: Your workspaces, prompts, notes, and uploaded attachments are strictly private. All data is encrypted in transit and at rest. We never sell your personal information or use your conversations to train public foundation models.
aboutPage.noFakeText: We do not display fabricated customer logos, fake user counters, or deceitful “unlimited” badges. Every price and credit metric corresponds directly to what our infrastructure and AI providers cost to run.
aboutPage.supportText: Have questions, feedback, or need enterprise support? Our support team responds to all inquiries within 3 business days.
